summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd (NYSE: LUD) filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing a signed MOU to acquire a 55% stake in Asia AI Data Centre Quantum Technology Company Ltd. The consideration is cash of USD 400,000 plus the issuance of ordinary shares valued at USD 535,000, totaling USD 935,000. The seller, Ms. Liu Liangping, is the target's CEO and Luda's COO, and she is married to Luda's CEO, Mr. Ma Biu. The board supports the strategic entry into data centre and AI computing infrastructure. The transaction is structured as a majority share acquisition, subject to definitive agreements and regulatory approvals. The MOU includes related-party considerations, as Ms. Liu is an insider. Watch for completion of due diligence and final terms; the small size and insider nature suggest low deal risk.
